newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 396 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 396 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 396 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 10 wheat contracts, 113 corn, 183 soybean, 52 soymeal, 5 soyoil, 20 oats and 13 rough rice futures contracts traded, along with 1 corn call and 1 soybean call option.

The overnight trend for corn was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower, soybeans were up 1/4 to 1-3/4 cents, wheat up 3/4 to down 1/2 cent, soymeal up 40 to 70 cents per ton, soyoil up 0.05 cent per lb, oats up 3/4 cent, and rough rice steady to up three cents per cwt.
